question.problem:
If $A={p,q,r}$ and $B={3,5},$ which of the following elements belong to $B\times (A\times A)?$

- $(5,(r,p))$
- $(q,(5,3))$
- $(3,q,p)$
question.worked_solution:
The Cartesian product $A\times B$ consists of all ordered pairs whose first coordinate belongs to $A$ and whose second coordinate belongs to $B.$

In this case, $A\times A$ consists of every combination of ${p,q,r}$ with ${p,q,r},$ as shown in the schematic below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14123139/assets/aad91ef7655fa8a5bf0c9852ee4e5e2166289087a56ac18e932ee3cce17164a0.png)

Hence, the set $A\times A$ is given by

$$
A\times A={(p,p),(p,q),(p,r),(q,p),(q,q),(q,r),(r,p),(r,q),(r,r)}.
$$

Note that 

$$
|A\times A|=|A|\cdot |A|=3\cdot 3=9.
$$

Now, the Cartesian product

$$
B\times (A\times A)
$$

consists of every combination of $B$ and $A\times A,$ as shown in the schematic below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14123139/assets/e573cecaa9333e071d980b1b03d65dafadd027506d2c2b9b6e8acfbe15d3be52.png)

Note that 

$$
|B\times (A\times A)|=|B|\cdot |A\times A|=2\cdot 9=18.
$$

From the given options, we see that only $(5,(r,p))\in B\times (A\times A).$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
